title: Implementation Plan
executive_summary: Example plan for adding a basic user profile feature in a web app. It outlines requirements, backend API, and UI delivery with tests and validations.
key_objectives: Define profile data model and API contract
Implement backend CRUD for profile data
Deliver a simple profile UI with validation
Add unit and integration tests for critical flows
high_level_approach: Use a two-phase delivery: Phase 1 defines data model and backend endpoints with tests; Phase 2 builds the frontend UI and end-to-end validations. Prioritize clear API contracts and automated tests at each phase.

phases.name: Backend Profile API
phases.goal: Provide a stable profile data model and CRUD API endpoints with tests.
phases.deliverable: Profile API endpoints documented and tested.

risks.description: Unclear profile field requirements cause rework.
risks.mitigation: Confirm required fields early and document API contract.

risks.description: Data validation gaps lead to bad inputs in storage.
risks.mitigation: Define validation rules and enforce in request handlers.

tasks.name: Define data model and API contract

sequential_steps.description: Draft profile schema with required and optional fields.
Write API contract for create/read/update endpoints.
sequential_steps.verification: Confirm endpoints and payloads in design doc.

sequential_steps.description: Add profile model and persistence layer.
Add integration tests for API endpoints.

phases.name: Profile UI
phases.goal: Provide a working profile page with form validation and API integration.
phases.deliverable: Profile page available in the app with tests.

risks.description: UI validation rules diverge from backend validation.
risks.mitigation: Reuse shared validation rules or document parity tests.

risks.description: API error handling is inconsistent in UI.
risks.mitigation: Define standard error response shape and map to UI states.

sequential_steps.description: Create profile page layout and components.
sequential_steps.verification: Manual UI check in dev build.

sequential_steps.description: Wire form to API endpoints with loading/error states.

quality_gates.description: UI matches required fields and validation rules.

sequential_steps.description: Create E2E test for profile update flow.
